title: Arthur Morgan's last sunrise in Red Dead Redemption 2
subject: arthur
description:
Which ending did your Arthur get? 👇

Arthur Morgan's final choice and how his honor decides his death. Spoilers for the ending of Red Dead Redemption 2.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Who would Arthur Morgan die for? That was his final choice.
Dying of tuberculosis, he watched Dutch turn on the gang, one friend at a time.
The real rat was Micah Bell, feeding Dutch's paranoia while selling them out to the Pinkertons.
So Arthur made one last promise: get John Marston home to his wife and son.
But that's not the end. On the mountain, he told John to run, and stayed behind.
With high honor, he dies alone watching one last sunrise. Without it, Micah finishes him.
In the end, it all came down to one question.
